streamlabs.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Streamlabs right now.

streamlabs.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a Streamlabs event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Streamlabs and it works without a connection.
streamlabs.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

streamlabs.isSignedIn.description: Checks whether your own Streamlabs app is connected, which the alert, wheel, points and donation-list functions need.

streamlabs.alertQueue.description: Controls your Streamlabs alert box. Needs your Streamlabs app connected.

streamlabs.createAlert.description: Shows your own alert in the Streamlabs alert box. At most 2 a minute (Cuebot waits). Needs your Streamlabs app connected.

parameters.type: Optional. donation (default), follow, subscription or host: whose style to use.

streamlabs.getDonations.description: Gets your latest Streamlabs donations, newest first. Needs your Streamlabs app connected.
streamlabs.getDonations.returns: A list of {id, user, amount, currency, formattedAmount, message, createdAt}.

streamlabs.getPoints.description: Gets a viewer's Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points. Needs your Streamlabs app connected.

streamlabs.addPoints.description: Adds (or with a negative amount removes) Streamlabs Cloudbot loyalty points. Needs your Streamlabs app connected.

streamlabs.widget.description: Spins the wheel, empties the tip jar or rolls the credits. Needs your Streamlabs app connected.
